publicTitle: What Has to Be True First?
question: Are some conditions gates that must be satisfied before comparison is allowed to begin?
comparator: Strongest physical comparator under the same frozen heldout false-admission criterion.
procedure: freeze admissibility definition before heldout inspection
apply SAS and strongest comparator to identical heldout cases
count false admissions and endpoint disagreements
adjudicate only under the frozen criterion and preserve a null result without retuning
environment: Implementation-neutral bounded diagnostic specification; no dependency on proprietary production runtime is required.
acceptanceCriteria: The reproduced disposition must follow the frozen false-admission criterion; unrelated positive results may not be substituted for SAS evidence.
verifier: Independent recomputation of the frozen admissibility/comparator counts against the public method record.
proprietaryBoundary: A neutral implementation may reproduce the published admissibility rule and comparator without the complete Diamond Gate Bridge implementation.
claimCeiling: Formalized noncompensatory admissibility object plus bounded diagnosis only; no cross-domain empirical superiority or universal noncompensation law.
